description.value: Wheelhouse Brewing Company is a craft brewery and full-service restaurant established in 2013, now housed inside Prince Rupert's original train station—a heritage landmark with 270° harbour views and an authentic Italian wood-fired pizza oven burning local red alder. Self-described as 'the wettest brewery in Canada,' it sits at the northern terminus of BC's Yellowhead Highway cycling corridor and serves award-winning craft beers alongside a rotating menu of wood-fired pizzas and coastal-inspired food.
